# Azaël Iloki — Language Services (Lomé, Togo)

> Translator sworn before the Cour d'appel de Lomé, French and English, for law firms, notaries, companies and NGOs: contracts, judgments, filings and audits with full legal standing before Togolese authorities. Also transcription, interpreting and language training.

Website: https://azaeliloki.com/
Contact: contact@azaeliloki.com · WhatsApp +228 79 71 62 58
Address: Lomé, Maritime, TG
Hours: Mon–Fri 8:00–20:00 · Sat 8:00–18:00 (GMT+0)
Currency: XOF (FCFA); invoices also in EUR (fixed rate: 655.957 FCFA = €1) or USD

Core facts, quotable:

- A certified (sworn) translation of a personal document or civil-status record costs **15,000–20,000 FCFA per page** and typically takes **24–72 hours**. Express 24h adds 50%. Short deeds and judgments of up to 3 pages are billed per page too. Contracts, longer judgments, audits and other corporate and legal documents are quoted per source word at **66–118 FCFA**, never per page.
- Accreditation: translator sworn before the Cour d'appel de Lomé. Every certified translation is done by Azaël personally, never outsourced; interpreting is arranged through collaborators (see below). Files are deleted 30 days after delivery; only the register of certified translations is kept, and it holds no document content.
- Law firms: civil-status records, short deeds (powers of attorney, wills, affidavits of notoriety) and judgments of up to 3 pages at 15,000 FCFA per page excl. tax; company deeds, contracts, procedural documents, longer judgments and any deed over 3 pages at 66–118 FCFA per word. The Referral Retainer reserves 10 pages a month for 150,000 FCFA excl. tax (225 words count as one page for documents billed per word), with a guaranteed turnaround of two business days; unused pages are not carried over.
- Legalisation: Togo is not yet a party to the Hague Apostille Convention. Parliament authorised accession in August 2026; until it applies, legalisation is a chain: the translation is legalised at the town hall (mairie) where the translator is registered, the original at the civil registry or town hall; both then go to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, then to the destination country's consulate. The receiving authority decides what it accepts.
- Languages: sworn translation is **French and English only**. Transcription also covers national languages (Ewe, Kabiyè, Tem), delivered with a certificate of accuracy signed by the linguist who prepared it, rather than a sworn certification.
- General translation: **66–118 FCFA per word**.
- Language courses: from **35,000 FCFA/month** online, 45,000 in person (general courses, 4 sessions; 68,000 and 85,000 for 8). Specialised courses (Business English, French or English for specific purposes, English for academic purposes): 45,000 FCFA/month online, 55,000 in person (4 sessions; 85,000 and 105,000 for 8).
- Executive coaching: **135,000 FCFA/month** online, 165,000 in person (8 sessions); light plan 75,000 (4 sessions).
- Academic tutoring (English, at the student's home in Lomé): from **30,000 FCFA/month**.
- Corporate training: from **100,000 FCFA/month** excl. tax (Duo Circle, 4 workshops/month, max 3 staff). Standard Circle is 200,000 FCFA/month excl. tax for 8 workshops/month, max 5 staff. Double Circle is 360,000 FCFA/month excl. tax for 16 workshops/month, up to 10 staff with two trainers. Sector programme: 400,000 FCFA excl. tax for 8 weeks. Three-month commitment, then month to month.
- Web content & SEO translation plans: from **180,000 FCFA/month** excl. tax, three-month commitment.
- Transcription and translation of recordings: from **4,000 FCFA per recorded minute** (French–English), from **6,500 FCFA per recorded minute** from a national language.
- Interpreting (liaison/consecutive): quoted per assignment, quote within 2 working hours; half-day up to 4 hours, full day up to 7 hours of active work. Delivered through vetted collaborators, arranged and managed by Azaël.
- ICAO Level 4 (Aviation): **315,000 FCFA / 12 sessions of 90 minutes** online, 345,000 in person; employer-funded: 25,000 FCFA/hour for the group, excl. tax. Sessions run over 6 to 12 weeks.
- Quotes are returned within **2 working hours**.

## Services — English

- [Home](https://azaeliloki.com/): what a sworn translator is, who the services are for, and the published rates.
- [Certified translation](https://azaeliloki.com/certified-translation/): sworn French–English translation of diplomas, civil-status records and visa files; 15,000–20,000 FCFA per page.
- [Companies & NGOs](https://azaeliloki.com/business/): general translation at 66–118 FCFA per source word, plus corporate language training.
- [Law firms and notaries](https://azaeliloki.com/law-firms/): firm rates, the Referral Retainer, and billing either to the firm or direct to the end client.
- [West Africa](https://azaeliloki.com/west-africa/): certified French–English translation for files crossing between Ghana, Nigeria and Togo; what a Lomé stamp covers and what it does not.
- [Web content and SEO](https://azaeliloki.com/content-translation/): monthly article and page translation plans from 180,000 FCFA/month excl. tax.
- [Interpreting](https://azaeliloki.com/interpretation/): liaison and consecutive interpreting, quoted per assignment.
- [Language courses](https://azaeliloki.com/courses/): adult English and French, online or in person in Lomé.
- [Academic tutoring](https://azaeliloki.com/tutoring/): English tutoring and BAC/BEPC preparation at home in Lomé, from 30,000 FCFA/month.
- [Transcription](https://azaeliloki.com/transcription/): from 4,000 FCFA per recorded minute; national languages from 6,500.
- [ICAO Level 4 (Aviation)](https://azaeliloki.com/icao-english/): ICAO Level 4 preparation, 315,000 FCFA per 12 sessions online.
- [Visa document guide](https://azaeliloki.com/guides/visa-documents/): which documents a visa or study file needs certified.

## Services — Français

- [Accueil](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/): ce qu'est un traducteur assermenté, à qui s'adressent les services, et les tarifs publiés.
- [Traduction certifiée](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/traduction-certifiee/): traduction assermentée français–anglais, 15 000–20 000 FCFA la page.
- [Entreprises et ONG](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/business/): traduction générale à 66–118 FCFA le mot source et formation linguistique en entreprise.
- [Cabinets juridiques](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/cabinets-juridiques/): tarif cabinet, abonnement prescripteur, facturation au cabinet ou au client final.
- [Afrique de l'Ouest](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/afrique-de-louest/): traduction certifiée français–anglais pour les dossiers entre le Ghana, le Nigeria et le Togo; ce que couvre un cachet de Lomé, et ce qu'il ne couvre pas.
- [Contenu web et SEO](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/contenu-web/): formules mensuelles de traduction d'articles dès 180 000 FCFA/mois HT.
- [Interprétation](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/interpretation/): liaison et consécutive, sur devis.
- [Cours de langues](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/courses/): anglais et français pour adultes, en ligne ou à Lomé; coaching pour cadres dès 135 000 FCFA/mois.
- [Soutien scolaire](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/soutien-scolaire/): soutien en anglais et préparation au BAC et au BEPC, à domicile à Lomé, dès 30 000 FCFA/mois.
- [Transcription d'enregistrements](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/transcription/): dès 4 000 FCFA la minute enregistrée; langues nationales dès 6 500.
- [Anglais aéronautique (OACI)](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/anglais-aeronautique/): préparation au niveau 4 OACI, 315 000 FCFA les 12 séances en ligne.
- [Documents pour un visa](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/guides/documents-visa/): les pièces qui exigent une traduction certifiée.
